articles.title: S&P 500 correction: Five forces behind the market sell-off
articles.description: The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average closed in correction territory, off 10% from their records. The Nasdaq Composite lost its gain for the year.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
articles.description: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

articles.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
articles.description: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

articles.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
articles.description: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

articles.title: How China is using summits to expand its global influence
articles.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping has helped coordinate yet another photo-op of global significance.

articles.title: An early breakdown in the polar vortex is threatening already depleted gas stocks
articles.description: Colder weather and low wind speeds could strain Europe’s gas market, where storage started winter at its lowest level in more than a decade.

articles.title: Europe's cyber weak spot is the everyday businesses nobody thought to protect
articles.description: Known vulnerabilities are leaving everyday businesses increasingly exposed to cyber sabotage, as AI enables cybercriminals to work better and faster.

articles.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
articles.description: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

articles.title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules

articles.title: Why Anthropic's blockbuster IPO couldn't escape the market correction

articles.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

articles.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
